problem: Autonomous or agent-generated repository changes can outrun safe human validation if authorization, current state, mutation identity, provider completion, and replay evidence are handled as separate weak signals.
invariant: Treat consequential repository mutation as one evidence-bound transaction: exact intent and bytes must be authorized against expected canonical state; required gates must pass; provider mutation must execute once; canonical readback must reconcile to the provider identity; terminal outcome must be receipt-backed.

failure_semantics.provider_failure: block completion and persist failure receipt
failure_semantics.temporary_stale_readback: boundedly reconcile using cache-busted repeated reads
failure_semantics.completed_replay: return duplicate-completed receipt without reading mutable head or mutating again

authority_contract.revocation: required after proof use and after post-mint audit failure

public_boundary: Mechanism and proof contract are public-safe; implementation remains private and hash-bound through implementation-inspection.json.
